places-lavadero-tello-iv-rio-frio.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-lavadero-tello-iv-rio-frio.story: From María it runs 218 km to María; allow about 3 h 46 of riding. On the way it passes Molinos II, Letreros de los mártires, Río frío and back through Letreros de los mártires. The highest point is about 1,450 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
